title: Storyline Day 1: External Port Scan, WAF/API Gateway 401/403 Bursts & VCN Flow Sweeps
description: Detects Day 1 of the 7-day multi-pillar adversary storyline: external reconnaissance and API enumeration bursts (HTTP 401/403 spikes) against shop and crm endpoints alongside anomalous inbound VCN Flow Log REJECT port sweeps from 198.51.100.214.
query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC WAF Security Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC VCN Flow Logs') and ('Client IP' = '198.51.100.214' or 'Source IP' = '198.51.100.214' or 'Response Code' in ('401', '403') or 'Action' = 'REJECT') | stats count as recon_events, distinctcount('Destination Port') as ports_probed, distinctcount('Request URL') as urls_probed by 'Log Source', 'Trace ID' | where recon_events >= 1 | sort -recon_events
falsepositives: Authorized external vulnerability assessment or scheduled DAST scanning windows
Public Internet background noise against perimeter load balancers
investigation_notes: Correlate Client IP / Source IP 198.51.100.214 across SOC WAF Security Logs and SOC VCN Flow Logs.
Pivot on Trace ID to inspect downstream OKE pod execution on Day 2.
